content: Keriaun Pahsohpa
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses nan Sapwtehn Sainai ni keieun sounpwong en keriaun pahr mwurin mehn Israel ko ar mweselsang Isip, e mahsanih,
“Ni kaeisek pahieun rahn en sounpwong wet, tepida nin soutik, mehn Israel kan pahn wia Sarawien Pahsohpa nin duwen koasoandi koaros en sarawi wet.”
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko re en wiahda Sarawien Pahsohpa,
oh nin soutik en kaeisek pahieun rahn ni keieun sounpwong re ahpw wiahda sarawio nan Sapwtehn Sainai. Re wiahda soahng koaros nin duwen me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses.
Ahpw mie aramas ekei me samin ong kaudok, pwehki ar sairada aramas mehla, irail eri sohte kak iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa rahno. Re ahpw patohla rehn Moses oh Aaron
oh patohwanohng ira, “Se me samin pwehki at sairada aramas mehla, ahpw dahme se sohte pahn iangki mehn Israel kan patohwandahng KAUN-O at tungoal meirong?”
Moses ahpw sapengkin irail, “Kumwail awih I lao ale kaweid sang rehn KAUN-O.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses
en patohwanohng mehn Israel ko, “Ni ahnsou me emen mehn Israel de emen kadaudoke kan pahn saminla pwehki eh sairada aramas mehla de e seiseiloakseli wasa doh, ahpw e men iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa,

e mweimweiong en iang wia sarawio ahpw mwurin sounpwoung ehu, nin soutik en kaeisek pahieun keriaun sounpwong. Soangen aramas menet pahn wia sarawio ni eh pahn tungoale pilawa me sohte doal ihs oh dihpw katik.
Sohte mehkot pahn luwehdi sang ni kisin tungoal pwukat ong manda sang rahno oh sohte tih pwoat rehn mahno pahn katipwitimwpeseng. Re pahn kapwaiada koasoandi koaros en Pahsohpa.

Ahpw mehmen me mwakelekel ong kaudok oh sohte seiseiloakseli wasa doh, ahpw sohte iang kapwaiada Pahsohpa, e solahr pahn iang wia kisehn nei aramas akan, pwehki eh sohte iang patohwandahng ie meirong ni ahnsou me kileldi. Aramas meno pahn pwukoahki eh sapwung.

“Ma mehn liki men me kin koukousoan rehmwail men iang wia Sarawien Pahsohpa, e pahn iang wia nin duwen koasoandi koaros en Sarawien Pahsohpa. Koasoandi ehute me pahn doadoahk ong aramas koaros, ong mehn liki de pwilidak kan.”
Pelien Depweko
Eri, rahn me Impwal me KAUN-O pahn kin ketiket loale eh kokouda, pelien depwek pali ahpw pwarada oh kipehdi. Nipwong, depweko kin mwomwen mpwulen kisiniei.
Ni ahnsou me pelien depweko kin mwekidida, mehn Israel ko kin mweselda; oh wasa me e kin uhdi ie, re pil kin uhdi oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan.
Sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O re kin mwekidwei, oh sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O re kin uhdi. Re kin mihmihte wasatehkis erein pelien depweko eh kin mihmi pohn Impwalo.
Eri, ma pelien depweko pahn kin mihmi werei pohn Impwalo, mehn Israel ko kin peikiong KAUN-O oh sohte kin mwekidwei.
Ekei ahnsou pelien depweko kin mihmihki pohn Impwalo rahnte depe; ahpw mehnda, re kin mihmihte de mwekidida sang ni kupwur en KAUN-O.

Ekei ahnsou pelien depweko kin mihmihte sang nin soutik lel nimenseng; eri, aramas ako kin mwesel ni ahnsou me e kin mwekidida. Mehnda ma ni rahn de nipwong, ahpw re kin mweselda ni ahnsou me pelien depweko kin mwekidida.

Mehnda ma e mihmihki rahn riau, de sounpwong ehu, de sounpar ehu, de pil reireisang, erein pelien depweko eh kin mihmi pohn Impwalo, aramas akan sohte kin mweselda; a ni eh pahn mwekidida, re ahpw kin mweselda.
Eri, re kin kauwada imwarail impwal, oh re kin kihdihsang oh mweselda, nin duwen koasoandi kan me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses.
